messages.author: a28ce37a2d809bbf
messages.subject: rsf for encounter distribution?
parts:
Hi Chris,
  During Animove, I estimated the encounter distributions between many pairs of female bears. I was wondering if it is possible to use the encounter distribution in rsf.fit instead of the UD? My colleagues would like me to investigate attributes of the encounter distribution to see if there are commonalities in the areas females are likely to encounter each other. If it is not possible to use the encounter distribution ini rsf.fit, do you have any suggestions of how I might proceed? 

Thanks,
Jenny

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: rsf for encounter distribution?
parts:
Hi Jenny,

No, but I wouldn't do it that way, anyhow. I would use distances() to help pull out the encounters, and then run a whole new analysis on that timeseries.

Best,
Chris
